en: Vintage sepia postcard divided into two photographs. The upper image shows a river running through a forested valley with a road and a few buildings on the far bank. The lower image shows a metal truss footbridge or small bridge crossing the same river, with steps leading up to it and wooded hills in the background. Between the images there is a printed German title and poem headed "Gruß aus Amerika" and signed "Ernst Scheffler, Penig."
